newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Baron de Ley sale to be launched Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Baron de Ley sale to be launched Wednesday.

text.p: The sale of up to 74.6 percent of Rioja wine producer Baron de Ley to domestic and foreign institutions will begin on Wednesday once the group's prospectus has been officially registered, the firm said on Tuesday.
Offers for the shares can be made through July 11 and the price will be set on July 13. The initial range for the sale price is between 1,950 and 2,250 per share.
Baron de Ley said it expected shares to be listed on the bourse from July 16.
The company has 5.09 billion pesetas of assets represented by 7,250,000 shares with a face value of 100 pesetas per share.
As announced earlier, the national tranche makes up 45 percent of the offer and the international offer 55 percent.
The group said its first-quarter sales rose 28.4 percent to 890 million pesetas, while operating revenues rose 7.4 percent to 337 million pesetas.
